summary: Antero Resources Corp filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026, disclosing the establishment of a commercial paper program. The company may issue unsecured short-term notes up to $1.65 billion, with maturities not exceeding 397 days. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, capex, acquisitions, and debt repayment. The company's senior unsecured revolving credit facility will serve as a liquidity backstop. No notes had been issued as of the filing date. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
